checklist.text: Room view at noon: no forest sound. Dive into the Hologram View: it fades in quietly
One-shots every 8 to 30 s, never the same twice running; the bed loops with no click or gap
Leave and re-enter: it starts from a different spot each time
Ducks under rain, the radio and the Esc menu
Fades out with the light at dusk, silent at night
Follows the Birds volume; silent in the store

description: A quiet forest bed (leaves, distant birds, 2:25 seamless stereo loop, `forest_day_bed.ogg`) plus nine far-off calls and rustles (`forest_day_1..9.wav`) dropped in at random every 8 to 30 s with random pitch, volume and side. Heard only in the Hologram View, only by day (fades with the light through dusk). Ducks under rain, the radio and the Esc menu; follows the Birds volume. Starts from a random spot on each visit. Made from your recording: loud bird events cut out of the bed and kept as the one-shots; one repeating 3.7 kHz bird (2:15 to 2:52 of the source) left out because it would give the loop away. Session 43. Files: `Ambience.cs` (new), `Sounds.cs` (loads and updates it; `Sounds.Update` takes `daylight` and `radioHeard`), `GameEngine.cs` (version, call), `resources/sounds/ambience/`.
title: 5.18 Forest ambience in the Hologram View
